note: UNDECIDED. CIT-007 names 'whitespace' and Unicode P and S. A zero-width space (U+200B, category Cf, not White_Space) inside a symbols-only quote is neither, so a literal reading lets it pass CIT-007 and fail later as CIT-004; the same goes for ZWJ, variation selectors and combining marks (M). Best guess CIT-004 here, but the rule's intent suggests CIT-007. Tabs (Cc, but White_Space) count as whitespace: CIT-007. The spec should say whether 'whitespace' means Unicode White_Space or category Z, and whether Cf/M/Cc characters count as content.
